Definition: from G5021; something orderly in arrangement (a troop), i.e. (figuratively) a series or succession:--order.
BiblicalUsage: Paul says every man in his own order: Christ the firstfruits, afterward they that are Christ's at His coming. The word is a military term for a troop in rank, a company standing in its place. Resurrection has an order, and Christ leads it.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the order comforts me: Christ first, then His own, each in turn, and nobody forgotten in the ranks.
